topic: What interference mitigation techniques are viable for overlapping service transmissions across geographically dispersed ground stations?
consensus_response: Overlapping service transmissions exacerbate interference, degrading network capacity. Beamforming minimizes effective area overlap by focusing signals towards specific receivers, reducing bandwidth usage and interference. While DSA offers dynamic allocation based on real-time analysis, it relies on accurate spectrum sensing and algorithms for optimal performance.  Further research should focus on adaptive modulation techniques that account for fading dynamics to improve spectral efficiency in challenging environments.
